title: Reborn as an Extra in a Magical Girl Anime: I'll Save Those Girls, But Only Because I Want to See Them Cry
synopsis:
I was obsessed with "clouding" — in my past life, that is.

For some reason, I've now been reincarnated as a mob character named Hayami Sota in a magical girl anime. This world — where magical girls get trapped in enemy schemes and pushed to the brink of total annihilation — is, to me, an absolute paradise.

One day, while secretly watching a battle unfold, some kind of demon god suddenly spoke to me.

"Wait — if I make a contract and become the most powerful being around, I can keep stopping the girls from getting completely wiped out... and keep enjoying their suffering indefinitely!?"

And so I took on the identity of a mysterious entity known as "Omega," silently watching over the magical girls and rescuing them time and time again. But things are starting to get a little... strange.

"Omega... will you make me one of your followers?"

Hold on — is she going yandere on me?! No no no, I need her to be suffering and miserable, not falling for me!
author: ぷらぷら

title: Valkyrie Bullet
synopsis:
When a Soldier Sets Foot on a Maiden's Battlefield, a Story Without Heroes Begins.

The near future — Earth is under invasion from otherworldly monsters known as "Gijuu," forced into a never-ending defensive war. Conventional weapons are useless, and the only means of resistance is the powered suit called the Valkyrie Dress — a mysterious force-equipped armor that only women can operate. The institution that trains and manages these women who fight clad in dresses of steel, Third Academy, receives a new transfer. His name is Hifumi Ren. Having survived a surgery with less than a 10% success rate, he is the world's only test pilot of an anti-Gijuu humanoid weapon —.
author: Mishima Yomu & Wai

title: Life as an Adventurer with the Banished Marquis’ Daughter
synopsis:
Erika Solnzari was exiled from her country.

The reason was her friendship with the Maiden of Light.

Erika, who earned the enmity of the royal family and great nobles scheming to marry the Maiden of Light, was supposed to be expelled from the academy attended by the kingdom’s nobility.

However, due to the intervention of a third party aiming to create discord between the royal family and the chancellor by attacking Erika, the daughter of the kingdom’s chancellor, she was accused of attempting to assassinate the Maiden of Light.

As a result, Erika Solnzari was unjustly exiled.

Fearing that the kingdom might fall if the Maiden of Light’s heart was clouded, the kingdom concocted a farce that Erika had eloped in a mismatched love affair.

The partner chosen for this farce was Shin Longdagger, the poor second son of a viscount. Although he understood that accepting this story would mean the end of his noble status, he gladly accepted it.

The reason was that Erika Solnzari was his first love.

title: Childhood Friends Became Popular Idols
synopsis:
I don’t want to work.

I think that’s a feeling that everyone has at least once. It was something I started thinking about when I was in elementary school. Even though I absolutely didn’t want to work, how could I avoid it? When I was troubled by that, two girls appeared before me. They were incredibly beautiful girls and also my childhood friends, but even if I consulted with them… wait a minute?

“Hey, I have something to consult with you two… I don’t want to work. Can you support me?”

It was a parasitic statement that should never have been agreed upon. However, in the present, ten years later, they had become idols. In order to support me for the rest of my life!

While enjoying such a guaranteed winning youth, new girls kept appearing before me…?
author: Kuroneko Doragon

title: The Villainess Who Was Dumped Got Married into My Family, a Mob Noble from the Frontier, and Turns Out, She’s an Amazing Capable Wife?
synopsis:
Ragna has reincarnated as the third son of a noble family with lands in the frontier.

Thrilled at the prospect of living freely in another world without the responsibility of inheriting the family estate, his excitement was short-lived. Following the death of his father and two brothers in battle, Ragna finds himself unexpectedly taking over the family.

Unfamiliar with managing the estate and continuing the family legacy, he now faces the challenge of navigating noble duties, including attending an elite academy in the capital. As if adjusting to these responsibilities wasn’t overwhelming enough, an arranged marriage to a high-ranking noble’s daughter is thrust upon him.

This is when Ragna recalls a crucial detail about his new reality – this world mirrors that of an otome game, where his fiancée is known as the game’s antagonist.
author: Tera

title: Dragon Gal's Nail Artist
synopsis: Hajime Azuma is a high schooler with a knack for building plastic models. One day, he gets called up to the rooftop by his classmate Sayori Goto — a demi-human gyaru with dragon blood running through her veins. Sayori might come across as one of those bright, bubbly social butterflies, but she's hiding a problem that's basically a life-or-death crisis for any self-respecting gyaru: her nails are too hard to paint. Having heard that nail art isn't so different from model-building, Sayori wants to recruit Hajime as her personal nail artist. The catch — Hajime has zero experience with nails. Zero. Still, he agonizes over it, experiments, and keeps pushing forward until he finally starts living up to her expectations. But then things start snowballing — pedicures get added to the mix, then a nail shoot for a swimsuit photo session with other demi-human gyarus, and suddenly his days are anything but quiet. A youth romantic comedy about a dragon gyaru and a model-building boy turned nail artist — begins now!
author: 折口良乃

title: I’m a Holy-Attribute Healer, and Now I’m the Support Medic for an All-Female Knight Order!
synopsis:
“These female knights are too cute! I don’t mind being relied on!”

Salt remembers that he is a reincarnated person the moment the woman, who is like a sister to him, announces that she wants to get married.

After his party disbanded, he begins a new life in the frontier of an Earl’s territory.

Although he is invited to join an all-female knight brigade, their intense gazes scare him, so he resolves to remain a perfect gentleman.

This is a le*d romantic comedy about misunderstandings between female knights and a healer who strives to behave gentlemanly.
author: イコ

title: Chained Soldier: Demon Defense Force Journal
synopsis:
The "Demon Defense Force" protects humanity from the "Shuuki" (monsters) that emerge from the alternate dimension known as the "Mato" (Demon Metropolis). Though the force is comprised entirely of women possessing unique supernatural abilities, Yuuki Wakura spends his busy days alongside them—serving as both a slave to the 7th Unit Commander, Kyouka Uzen, and the caretaker of the 7th Unit dormitory.

Of course, his position comes with plenty of perks! Sometimes he receives his usual "rewards" during one-on-one training sessions with Kyouka, and other times he gets a relaxing massage from Shushut Chimai while training at the Azuma family's intensive boot camp...!?

Meanwhile, Tenka Izumo—the Commander of the 6th Unit, who had never understood the concept of "love" until meeting Yuuki—finds her feelings for him growing stronger the more time they spend together.

This light novel adaptation is penned by Takahiro himself, the original writer of the hit manga series!
author: タカヒロ

title: When I Said, “I Want a Beautiful and Rich Girlfriend,” a Girl with Circumstances Showed Up
synopsis:
“Just being beautiful is not love.”

This is a slightly mature adolescent romantic comedy questioning the meaning of falling in love!

Shino Iori (virg*n), a college student in Fukuoka, becomes engaged to Tendou Tsukasa, a well-known celebrity on campus, because of an unintentional comment he made to his family.

She is a beauty and rich—however, Iori is put off by his fiancée, who is rumored to “sleep with anyone” and Tsukasa is aggressively coming onto him… where will their future go!?

This is the start of a ‘slightly mature’ romantic comedy of a breaking-off-engagement genre that questions the meaning of falling in love!!
author: 小宮地千々

title: The Heroines of a Gal Game Who Avoided the End of Death Read My [Diary] and Found Out My Secret
synopsis:
The heroines have turned into dangerous yanderes who worship me. Why…?

As a reincarnator, “I” know that this world is the gal game 【Love or Dead】.

In 【LoD】, there are only two options for the heroines: either they end up with the protagonist, or they die. Every heroine who isn’t chosen meets her death — a total kusoge.

And for some reason, it’s already determined that even I, just a mob character, will get dragged into that fate.

The only way for both the heroines and me to survive is the harem end.

Determined to absolutely reach the harem end, I desperately tried to support the protagonist from the shadows.

But I kept making the wrong choices over and over again, and ended up at the worst possible bad end — where no one ends up with anyone.

In that hopeless situation, I resolved to sacrifice myself alone. I pushed Sakurazuki out of the way as she was about to be run over by a car. And then━━━
author: Addict
